fields.summary_ko.0: RBC set a $225 target price for SpaceX (SPCX) with 50% upside potential, though S&P Global warned of hyperscalers' hidden AI debt
fields.summary_ko.1: SpaceX recorded Q3 revenue of $14.6B (161% year-over-year increase) and operating profit of $4.4B, with the Starlink segment posting revenue of $5.25B and operating profit of $2.4B
fields.summary_ko.2: SpaceX's AI capital expenditure is expected to increase from $19.6B last quarter to $35–40B this quarter, with $40B of its $7 trillion four-year AI investment plan not reflected as debt on the financial statements
